DISCOVERY 612, PRESENT: WILLIAM REILLY, ESQ. FOR DEFENDANTS/MOVING PARTIES, UNUM LIFE INSURANCE COMPANY OF AMERICA. TERRENCE J. COLEMAN, ESQ. FOR PLAINTIFF/OPPOSING PARTY. MOTION ARGUED. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED. DEFENDANTS' MOTION TO COMPEL DISCOVERY RESPONSES IS DENIED AS IT SEEKS A FURTHER RESPONSE TO INTERROGATORY NO. 22 AS IT IS OVERLY BROAD. IF THE REQUEST WERE LIMITED TO THE IDENTIFICATION OF EXPENSES AND BILLS FOR WHICH PLAINTIFF HAS BEEN UNABLE TO MAKE TIMELY PAYMENTS, THE QUESTION MIGHT BE SUFFICIENTLY NARROW. THE MOTION IS DENIED AS TO DOCUMENT REQUEST NOS. 18 AND 23 AS THEY ARE OVERLY BROAD AND IRRELEVANT. AS THE MOTION SEEKS VERIFICATIONS, PLAINTIFF IS ORDERED TO VERIFY ALL OF HIS RESPONSES WITHIN 10 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. THE REMAINDER OF THE MOTION IS MOOT. THE COURT WILL NOT DETERMINE THE ADEQUACY OF ANY PREVIOUSLY MADE SUPPLEMENTAL RESPONSES. DEFENDANT'S REQUEST FOR SANCTIONS IS DENIED. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
